_comment: Maintenance advisory rules per fault family (backend/twin/advisory.py). do_now is keyed by urgency level; maintenance applies after landing. Prototype guidance based on general piston-engine practice, not certified procedures.

oil_pressure.title: Oil pressure failure developing

MONITOR: Monitor oil pressure and oil temperature closely.
CAUTION: Reduce power to lower bearing load.
Plan to end the mission early.
WARNING: Abort the mission and return to base.
CRITICAL: Land as soon as possible: bearing seizure risk.

maintenance: Check oil level and look for leaks.
Inspect the oil pump, oil filter and pressure relief valve.
Verify the oil pressure sender against a mechanical gauge.

overheating.title: Engine overheating

CAUTION: Reduce power and, if possible, descend into cooler air.
WARNING: Reduce power to the minimum needed to hold altitude.
Abort the mission and return to base.
CRITICAL: Land as soon as possible: detonation and piston damage risk.

maintenance: Check ignition timing and fuel mixture (a lean mixture raises EGT and CHT).
Inspect the cooling path and the exhaust system.
Borescope the cylinder for heat damage.

cooling.title: Cooling degradation

MONITOR: Monitor CHT and oil temperature trends.
CAUTION: Reduce power and, if possible, descend into cooler air.
WARNING: Reduce power and abort the mission.
CRITICAL: Land as soon as possible: the engine cannot shed heat.

maintenance: Inspect cooling fins for dirt or damage.
Check baffles, shrouds and cowling seals.
Check the oil cooler for blockage.

fuel_starvation.title: Fuel starvation

CAUTION: Check the fuel supply: tank selection, pump and fuel quantity.
WARNING: Prepare for loss of power: head for the nearest safe landing area.
CRITICAL: Land immediately: the engine is losing power.

maintenance: Inspect the fuel filter, fuel pump and fuel lines.
Drain and check fuel for water or contamination.
Check tank venting.

injector.title: Injector abnormality

MONITOR: Monitor EGT and fuel flow versus commanded fuel.
WARNING: Reduce power and abort the mission.
CRITICAL: Land as soon as possible: lean running damages the engine.

maintenance: Clean or replace the injector.
Flow-test the injector and check the spray pattern.
Check the fuel rail pressure regulator.

misfire.title: Misfire

CAUTION: Reduce power and avoid rapid throttle changes.
WARNING: Abort the mission and return to base.
CRITICAL: Land as soon as possible: engine power is unreliable.

maintenance: Inspect and gap the spark plugs.
Check ignition leads and the ignition module.
Run a compression test.

instability.title: Combustion instability

CAUTION: Reduce power and avoid rapid throttle changes.
WARNING: Abort the mission and return to base.
CRITICAL: Land as soon as possible: combustion is erratic.

maintenance: Check ignition timing.
Check fuel quality and the injector spray pattern.
Inspect the intake for air leaks.

vibration.title: Abnormal vibration

CAUTION: Reduce RPM to lower vibration loads.
WARNING: Reduce RPM and abort the mission.
CRITICAL: Land as soon as possible: risk of structural or bearing failure.

maintenance: Balance the propeller and inspect it for damage.
Inspect engine mounts and isolators.
Check crankshaft bearings for wear.

electrical.title: Electrical system fault

MONITOR: Monitor bus voltage and alternator current.
CAUTION: Keep RPM high enough for the alternator to carry the bus.
WARNING: Shed non-essential loads and abort the mission: running on battery.
CRITICAL: Land as soon as possible: avionics power is at risk.

maintenance: Check the alternator drive and output.
Test the voltage regulator.
Check the battery state and terminals.

cht_sensor.title: CHT sensor drift or failure

MONITOR: Cross-check CHT against EGT and oil temperature.
CAUTION: Don't act on CHT alone: EGT and oil temperature are normal, so the engine is likely fine.
WARNING: Treat CHT as unavailable; fly on EGT and oil temperature.
CRITICAL: Treat CHT as unavailable; fly on EGT and oil temperature.

maintenance: Replace or recalibrate the CHT thermocouple.
Inspect the sensor wiring and connector.

unclassified.title: Unclassified anomaly

CAUTION: Reduce power and monitor the affected subsystem.
WARNING: Abort the mission and return to base.

maintenance: Inspect the affected subsystem.
